name: Golosa
source: Sergey, in a completely unknown way, got on the same bus as Semyon. Waking up in "Sovenok", he discovers that an unknown voice has appeared in his head. The unexpected guest teases the hero and gives orders. Will you listen to him, or will you follow your own path? The choice is yours.
translation: 谢尔盖以一种完全不为人知的方式与谢苗登上了同一辆公共汽车。在“索维诺克”中醒来，他发现自己的脑海中出现了一个未知的声音。不速之客戏弄英雄并下达命令。你会听他的，还是走自己的路？选择权在你。
